facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 73°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Sevenmile Marsh (5,690 ft) and Annie Springs (6,020 ft) 38 to 58 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Sevenmile Marsh
evidence.detail: left April 6; earlier seasons: June 7 (2023), June 3 (2024), June 2 (2025)

evidence.name: Annie Springs
evidence.detail: left May 3; earlier seasons: June 15 (2023), June 9 (2024), June 10 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Sevenmile Marsh (5,690 ft) and Annie Springs (6,020 ft).

evidence.name: Sevenmile Marsh
evidence.detail: 1.5 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 47.2 in (2023), 37.8 in (2024), 43.7 in (2025)

evidence.name: Annie Springs
evidence.detail: 9.0 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 58.7 in (2023), 44.6 in (2024), 61.7 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 18 and May 7, carried from the melt-out dates at Sevenmile Marsh (5,690 ft) and Annie Springs (6,020 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Sevenmile Marsh
evidence.detail: melted out April 6, 263 ft above the pass; points to March 9 to April 25

evidence.name: Annie Springs
evidence.detail: melted out May 3, 593 ft above the pass; points to March 28 to May 19
